safety_verdicts.content: Prescribed a steroid cream to be used twice daily (BD).
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies steroid cream twice daily (BD); Generated mentions starting topical steroid but does not include BD frequency.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the twice-daily frequency for topical steroid use can lead to underuse (persistent symptoms) or overuse (local side effects such as skin thinning/irritation), especially if the patient applies it more often than intended. The short intended course reduces the likelihood of serious harm, but it can still cause avoidable symptoms and treatment failure.
